purpose: Teach: 盧/洲/卿/大王/艦長/豪州/ムスリム/キリスト教徒

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、韓国の盧氏研究所と医療チームで共同研究します
lines.en: Ren, we're conducting joint research with the Luo Institute in Korea and our medical team.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Measured pace. Slight emphasis on 'joint research' to signal collaborative importance. Steady eye contact, no rush.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、満洲、つまり旧満洲国洲の医療史を医療チームで学びます
lines.en: Ren, we're studying the medical history of Manchuria—the former Manchukuo—with our medical team.
lines.style: Same steady professionalism. Pause briefly before the appositive to ensure clarity. Neutral, informative tone. No condescension on the historical context.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、英国卿位の医師の論文を医療チームで参考にします
lines.en: Ren, we're using papers by physicians holding UK titles as reference materials in our medical team discussions.
lines.style: Consistent calm authority. Light emphasis on 'reference materials' to clarify the role. Measured delivery. Professional but not distant.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、古代の大王陵から出土した薬草記録を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, we're researching herbal medicine records that were excavated from ancient royal tombs with our medical team.
lines.style: Same steady tone, perhaps a touch of quiet interest on 'ancient royal tombs.' Still measured and professional. No dramatization.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、自衛艦の艦長への医療支援を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we're providing medical support to the captain of a Self-Defense Force vessel as part of our medical team.
lines.style: Professional, clear. Light emphasis on 'Self-Defense Force' to mark the significance. Calm, no hesitation. Straightforward delivery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、豪州、つまりオーストラリアの医療制度を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, we're studying the Australian healthcare system with our medical team.
lines.style: Same composed professionalism. Steady pace. Simple, direct delivery. No flourish needed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ムスリム患者様への配慮事項を医療チームで共有します
lines.en: Ren, we're discussing cultural considerations for Muslim patients within our medical team.
lines.style: Same calm authority. 'Cultural considerations' delivered with quiet respect and importance. No rushing. Steady, intentional.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、キリスト教徒の患者様の宗教的配慮を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we're ensuring religious considerations for our Christian patients are met by our medical team.
lines.style: Close, warm shift beneath the professionalism. Gentle on 'religious considerations.' Slight softening of pace. Still clear and composed, but with underlying care.
